nativeToJs.note: The only direction that fires window.__JUCE__.backend.addEventListener on the page.

pageLoaded.note: Emitted by the page on (re)load; the host closes open gestures and answers with syncAllParams.

valueConvention.value: ALWAYS normalised 0..1, the same scale AudioProcessorParameter::getValue() reports. Clamped by the native side before entering the APVTS.
valueConvention.real: Denormalised value in parameter units. Native -> JS only, informational.
valueConvention.text: Display text formatted by the parameter. Native -> JS only, informational.
valueConvention.gesture: JS -> native only: 'begin' opens a host gesture, 'change' continues it, 'end' closes it. Absent means 'change'. Unknown phases reject the message.

syncAllParams.sentWhen: Page (re)load, requestState, or host-side decision to resynchronise.

fields.version: Monotonic counter, incremented on every snapshot.
fields.parameters: Array of { id, value, real, text } in layout order, one per APVTS parameter.

parameterChanged.sentWhen: A parameter moved on the native side since the last report (value-diffed poll), or an external/automation change.

fields.id: Parameter ID as defined by the APVTS layout.

parameterChanged.sentWhen: The user moved a control on the page, in any phase of a drag.

fields.id: Parameter ID as defined by the APVTS layout.

requestState.sentWhen: The page mounts, or wants a fresh full snapshot for any reason.

behaviour.echoSuppression: A value applied from JS marks the entry as reported; the native poller never echoes it back to the page that sent it.
behaviour.outgoingDelivery: Outgoing changes are POLLED via publishPendingChanges() (value-diffed), never pushed from parameter listeners. One message per changed parameter per poll.
behaviour.gestureLifecycle: begin opens at most one gesture per parameter; end closes it; a page reload closes every gesture the page left open (closeOpenGestures). An end without begin is tolerated and still writes the value.
behaviour.malformedInput: Malformed messages and unknown actions/ids are counted in stats, never thrown. Unknown parameter ids are counted separately from malformed messages.
behaviour.transportGuards: The native side MUST emit with emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible and MUST NOT call window.__JUCE__.backend.emitEvent from C++ (wrong channel direction, message silently discarded). Enforced by Tests/webviewBridgeDirectionTest.mjs.
behaviour.localMode: Without window.__JUCE__.backend the page keeps working with local state only; all sends are no-ops.
